CREATE FUNCTION correlate(x int) RETURNS TABLE(a int, b int) LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$SELECT correlate.x, data.x FROM data ORDER BY data.x$$
SELECT d.x, f.a, f.b FROM data d CROSS JOIN LATERAL correlate(d.y) f ORDER BY 1,2,3
SELECT d.x, f.a, f.b FROM data d, correlate(d.y) f ORDER BY 1,2,3
SELECT data.x, f.a, f.b FROM data, correlate(data.y) f ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT * FROM data d, arg_error(d.x) f LIMIT 0

SELECT d.x, f.value FROM data d, with_cte(d.y) f ORDER BY 1,2

$$

CREATE FUNCTION catch_error(x int) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$BEGIN IF x = 1 THEN BEGIN RETURN procedural_error(x)::text; EXCEPTION WHEN division_by_zero THEN RETURN SQLSTATE || '|' || SQLERRM; END; END IF; RETURN 'ok'; END$$
SELECT * FROM catch_error(1)
SELECT * FROM catch_error(2)
CREATE FUNCTION rethrow_error(x int) RETURNS int LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$BEGIN IF x = 1 THEN BEGIN RETURN procedural_error(x); EXCEPTION WHEN division_by_zero THEN RAISE; END; END IF; RETURN 2; END$$
SELECT * FROM rethrow_error(1)
SELECT * FROM rethrow_error(2)
